s32.prompt: Raghava, a 56-year-old Telugu father, speaks in Telugu to someone near them; terrified, eyes red-rimmed, wide and wet with fear, brows raised and knotted together, deep forehead creases, jaw clenched and trembling, no smile. Only they speak and their lips follow the speech exactly; anyone else in frame stays silent and still. A clean, bright modern private hospital corridor outside the operating theatre: warm white light, pastel-green walls, a potted plant, steel benches. After the last word they fall silent, lips closed, listening, until the end. Static camera. Audio: only the voice, no music.
